anya: Quick thread We need a compact pattern for required indicators and error handling in the Account Create flow. Designers want minimal labels; accessibility team wants explicit markers. Thoughts? sam: Prefer a tiny visual badge 'Req' after the label + an sr-only 'Required' before the label for screen readers. Keeps layout tight and reads correctly. li: Agree. Also: reserve a one-line slot under each field for errors to avoid pushing the primary CTA on mobile. Use a subtle fade to reveal the message. sofia: Accessibility notes: field-level messages should be role=status with aria-live=polite. Form-level summaries should be role=alert / aria-live=assertive and receive focus when visible. anya: Implementation sketch: ```
``` sam: Sounds good. Keep the error-slot in the DOM empty by default so spacing is stable. When showing an error update the inner text and apply a class for animation. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. li: For destructive confirmations: security wants typed confirm for important deletions. Recommended rule: typed-confirm when deleting more than 1 item, deleting resources with side-effects, or when deletion impacts billing. Otherwise, confirm modal + undo toast. sofia: Don't block paste in typed-confirm inputs. Instead require either typing the exact resource name or typing a keyword like DELETE; for bulk deletes the keyword is simpler. Server-side should normalize and validate. anya: Edge-case: error messages announced while animation is playing might be missed. Ensure live region text updates immediately (no animation delay). Use animation for visual only. sam: Also add a tiny inline 'pasted' indicator if the user pastes into the typed-confirm input, so it's transparent. li: Decision check: 1) visible 'Req' badge + sr-only Required token, 2) reserve error slot per field + fade-in (reduced-motion aware), 3) field-level polite live, form-level assertive summary with focus, 4) typed-confirm policy for high-impact deletes (no paste-block, server normalization), 5) show "pasted" hint when applicable. Any objections? sofia: +1 sam: +1 anya: I'll make a tiny prototype and open a PR with copy variants and ARIA notes. tagging eng and intl. design-bot: Created issue #3401 compact-req-badge + error-slot + typed-confirm (assigned to anya)
